about_the_game:
Zegelon: Hardcore Arena blends intense multiplayer shoot-and-slash combat with battle royale, survival and management mechanics. In this dark post-apocalyptic fantasy world, players engage in brutal gladiatorial combat with no second chances, crafting characters in the spirit of old-school roleplaying games. While expanding their House in the hierarchy of the rising Empire.

A Dark Post-Apocalyptic Fantasy World

Step into a savage world where desperate prisoners fight for survival under the gaze of the tyrannical rising Empire. Dive into a dark, unforgiving world where Houses rise, Legends fall, and Gold and Glory awaits.

Chance Creates Fighters, Strategy Creates Legends

Roll the Dice of Fate to buy your prisoners, shape their destiny through strategic upgrades and Arena victories. No two fighters are alike—adapt your tactics and outsmart your rivals to dominate the Arena.

Permanent Character Death

Every battle is a life-or-death experience—there are no second chances. The tension of every encounter is unmatched, making each fight a heart-pounding experience where only the best survive.

Skill-Based and Brutal Combat System

Combat is visceral, skill-based, and punishing—timing and positioning is key. True skill separates the fighters from the weak; every move, parry, and strike can mean life or death.

The Arenas of Zegelon

The Empire's Arena League has transformed ancient Arenas and sacred sites of conquered strongholds into battlegrounds of chaos and bloodshed. Prisoners thrust into merciless rituals, forced to survive not only each other but also relentless beasts and deadly hazards.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
